an5.194:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.194:1.2: tena kho pana samayena kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo licchavīnaṃ kammantaṃ kāreti
an5.194:1.3: addasā kho kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo piṅgiyāniṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
an5.194:2.1: handa kuto nu bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī āgacchati divā divassāti.
an5.194:2.2: idhāhaṃ bho āgacchāmi samaṇassa gotamassa santikāti
an5.194:2.3: taṃ kiṃ maññati bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ paṇḍito maññeti
an5.194:2.4: kocāhaṃ bho ko ca samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jānissāmi
an5.194:2.5: sopi nūnassa tādisova yo samaṇassa gotamassa paññāveyyattiyaṃ jāneyyāti
an5.194:2.6: uḷārāya khalu bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsāya pasaṃsatīti
an5.194:2.7: kocāhaṃ bho ko ca samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pasaṃsissāmi
an5.194:2.8: pasaṭṭhapasaṭṭho ca so bhavaṃ gotamo seṭṭho devamanussānanti
an5.194:2.9: kiṃ pana bhavaṃ piṅgiyānī atthavasaṃ sampassamāno samaṇe gotame evaṃ abhippasannoti
an5.194:3.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso aggarasaparititto na aññesaṃ hīnānaṃ rasānaṃ piheti
an5.194:3.2: evameva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:3.3: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso
an5.194:3.4: tato tato na aññesaṃ puthusamaṇappavādānaṃ piheti
an5.194:4.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso jighacchādubbalyapareto madhupiṇḍikaṃ adhigaccheyya
an5.194:4.2: so yato yato sāyetha labhateva sādurasaṃ asecanakaṃ
an5.194:4.3: evameva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:4.4: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso
an5.194:4.5: tato tato labhateva attamanataṃ labhati cetaso pasādaṃ.
an5.194:5.4: yadi mūlato yadi majjhato yadi aggato
an5.194:5.6: evameva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:5.7: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso
an5.194:5.8: tato tato adhigacchati pāmujjaṃ adhigacchati somanassaṃ.
an5.194:6.1: seyyathāpi bho puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno
an5.194:6.2: tassa kusalo bhisako ṭhānaso ābādhaṃ nīhareyya
an5.194:6.3: evameva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:6.4: yaṃdi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso
an5.194:7.1: seyyathāpi bho pokkharaṇī acchodakā sātodakā sītodakā setodakā supatiṭṭhā ramaṇīyā
an5.194:7.2: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito
an5.194:7.3: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nhātvā ca pivitvā ca sabbadarathakilamathapariḷāhaṃ paṭippassambheyya
an5.194:7.4: evameva kho bho yato yato tassa bhoto gotamassa dhammaṃ suṇāti
an5.194:7.5: yadi suttaso yadi geyyaso yadi veyyākaraṇaso yadi abbhutadhammaso
an5.194:8.1: evaṃ vutte kāraṇapālī brāhmaṇo uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇajānumaṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā tikkhattuṃ udānaṃ udānesi
an5.194:12.1: abhikkantaṃ bho piṅgiyāni abhikkantaṃ bho piṅgiyāni
an5.194:12.2: seyyathāpi bho piṅgiyāni nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telappajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā piṅgiyāninā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
an5.194:12.3: esāhaṃ bho piṅgiyāni taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
an5.194:12.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ piṅgayānī dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
